name: Coordinate a complex public process
short_description: Coordinate a multi-stage public process involving evidence, consultation, deadlines, objections, and auditable decisions.
self_assessment: I can coordinate one five-stage public process without help and preserve every required decision record.
description: Coordinate a multi-stage public process involving evidence, consultation, deadlines, objections, and auditable decisions. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Coordinate consultation and submission across five stages
